rules.received: R8.15 brief §7-§14 (Mohammad promoted it to an Urban rule)

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification explicitly overrides it

rules.applicability_rule: a doorway serving such a room: either side carries the room type through an authoritative, TRADE-SCOPED room-type map (never raw text alone)
not_applicable_to: external entrances (unless separate project evidence exists)
PAINTRY / pantry (not named by the owner)

measurement.rise_is: VERTICAL height above the adjoining finished floor
measurement.extent: the FULL CLEAR DOOR OPENING WIDTH x the physical threshold depth

floor_interfaces.wet: wet floor tile ends at the wet-side marble edge
floor_interfaces.dry: dry porcelain ends at the dry-side marble edge
floor_interfaces.marble: owns the complete threshold footprint (no half tile inside it)

supersedes_in_scope: QORTUBA-NEW-DRY-WET-TRANSITION-AT-DOOR-PLANE-OWNER-001@v1 where the rule applies (the split stays in force for any dry / wet door the rule does not cover)
never: a waterproofing extent change
a slope
a drainage
a material rate or price
20 mm as a horizontal width or depth
a universal horizontal depth
a hydraulic claim

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification explicitly overrides it

conditions: the opening genuinely has no door
the jamb is a real physical vertical surface
the floor finish reaches the jamb

rules.principle: SKIRTING FOLLOWS REAL SKIRTING-ELIGIBLE WALL SURFACE AT FLOOR LEVEL; a plan-cut opening is not a floor opening without vertical evidence
rules.trade: SKIRTING (and the hidden profile on the same path, US-08)
never: skirting across a clear opening
a door jamb return
a topology closure as material
a window deduction from plan geometry alone
a sill height transferred between projects

method.principle: WALL FINISH HEIGHT IS NOT A COMPANY-WIDE NUMBER: it is established per floor / measurement scope and per trade
hierarchy: derived clear height from authoritative vertical components

never: URBAN_DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT
a wall height from floor-to-floor alone
one floor's height on another
a derivation with an unknown component

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project instruction states the reveal finish

method.porcelain: ONLY when explicitly requested / shown / project-authorised
method.paint: on a reveal owned by a painted dry surface; never invented in a wet / service room
method.sliding_doors: side-jamb ownership follows the aluminium profile / frame position where the source shows it; otherwise PLASTER default
method.ambiguity: a reveal whose owning side the source does not establish is QUESTION / BLOCK for that reveal only

never: porcelain because an adjacent room is wet
every reveal one finish
one reveal in two room finishes

scope.applies_to: every Urban project unless a project specification states the column finish

method.principle: an EXPOSED column face inside a room follows the surrounding room treatment
requires: PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (the face is a room-facing boundary of the certified room)
dry_area: SKIRTING (on the existing wall-contact path only)
wet_full_wall_tile_area: PORCELAIN / WALL TILE (the room's wall-tile trade and height)
method.height: the room's own authorised wall-finish height for that trade
method.physical_class: COLUMN_FACE stays its own class; it is never merged into WALL_FACE

never: a finish because an object is structurally a column
a finish on a hidden / embedded / wall-buried face
paint on a wet / full-wall-tile column
normal skirting in a full-wall-tile room
new skirting where the contact path already covers the face

scope.applies_to: every Urban project: exposed interior duct / boxed-out faces where the surrounding DRY room treatment applies

method.principle: an exposed interior duct / boxed-out face takes the surrounding dry-room treatment
requires: OWNER_PHYSICAL_AUTHORITY (the duct is established as a built obstacle)
PHYSICAL_EXPOSURE (room-facing faces of the certified room only)
dry_area: SKIRTING (on the existing wall-contact path only)
method.height: the room's own authorised dry wall-finish height
method.physical_class: OBSTACLE / DUCT_FACE stays its own class; it is never merged into WALL_FACE

never: a finish on faces against existing walls, internal faces, non-room-facing faces or faces outside the measurement region
a finish for a generic obstacle without owner physical authority
a wet-room treatment by analogy (not stated)
new skirting where the contact path already covers the face
